doc.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]

title: Budd asks about Rowe's background; Dave Brubeck
summary: Rowe describes his parents and saxophone; talk turns to Paul Desmond, Brubeck and Joe Morello.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: All right. Well I want to thank you for your time today, and ...
Well I’ve taken more of it than I deserved, but I certainly enjoyed talking and listening and you could tell me, how did you get into this business?
Did your father play the piano or your mother?

My parents were amateur musicians, just during school, but they loved music, and I started listening to Glenn Miller and they would take me out to see the Glenn Miller band although it wasn’t Glenn. But I got into saxophone and then just started.
Yeah I’m a saxophone player and got into Paul Desmond and then Cannonball Adderly. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -21-
Yes. Paul Desmond was with Jack, John, what’s the piano player?

Dave Brubeck. The only thing I know about him, his birthday is December the 6, same as mine. Yeah, but I don’t know what year. I do know, I’ve heard him play. And he plays interesting music for sure. It’s not my style to be able to play as well as he does. And the drummers he’s had have been spectacular.
